- Hazel: 54,871 kg
- Elm: 52,217 kg
- Cedar: 48,002 kg
- Ginkgo: 69,662 kg
- Dogwood: 51,144 kg

Now I'll sort from lightest to heaviest:
1. Ivy: 1,820 kg (lightest)
2. Cedar: 48,002 kg
3. Dogwood: 51,144 kg
4. Elm: 52,217 kg
5. Hazel: 54,871 kg
6. Fir: 67,746 kg
7. Ginkgo: 69,662 kg (heaviest)
